description: Two drama companies share one auditorium for rehearsal. One of them plays "Peach Blossom", another plays "Secret Love".Though all aspects, they find themselves telling the same story: the story of Chinese people forced to leave home.

Title: 774. Boulevard of the Revolution
description: A love story between a teenager girl and a small time mob set in Belgrade during the times of great political turmoil.

Title: 775. Valayam
description: Sreedharan is a kind-hearted lorry driver who helps people in times of need. However, his life becomes hell when his beloved friend tries to interfere in his personal matters.

Title: 776. The Strange Tale of Oyuki
description: The film tells the story of Japanese writer Kafu Nagai (1879-1959), a man about sixty with a huge reputation of seducer who falls madly in love for a young geisha named Oyuki. Meticulous and smartly dressed, Nagai patiently wrote in his diary his thoughts during many years. A melancholy reflection on the passage of time and a brilliant interpretive exercise.

Title: 778. Umar 55 Ki Dil Bachpan Ka
description: After Dhaniram distributes his wealth amoungst his children, they all turn arrogant and leave him. Just when Dhaniram is left helpless, his twin brother Maniram comes up with an ingenious plan.

Title: 779. Pain of Love
description: A young woman who falls in love with her teacher is hit by heartache and challenges she is not prepared for and struggles to escape her dark frame of mind.

Title: 780. Vietnam Colony
description: Two men tries to persuade a bunch of colony residents to relocate to another location for the sake of a corporate project, while the residents including a number of goons, comes in their way.

Title: 781. Rock Hudson's Home Movies
description: Documentary about the career and eventual death from AIDS of actor Rock Hudson.

Title: 782. Hit the Dutchman
description: Arthur Flegenheimer is a thief recently released from prison who is recruited by noted hood Jack "Legs" Diamond. Flegenheimer changes his name to Dutch Schultz and, thanks to his brutal and unscrupulous ways, rises to become Diamond's right-hand man during the bleak days of Prohibition.

Title: 783. Ajeeb Dastaan Hai Yeh
description: Romantically influenced by novels and movies, Meenakshi Sinha alias Mini lives with her advocate father Jagat Narayan in a palatial house. She studies in college where she meets with a handsome young man named Ketan Kapoor and both fall in love with each other. When her dad finds out, he instructs her not to meet nor see Ketan again, but she ignores his instructions, elopes, marries Ketan, and moves into a hotel room. Jagat refuses to have to do anything with his daughter. After a few months, the young couples' money runs out, Ketan is unable to find work, as he does not even have a diploma, and they move into Zeba's, a friend of Mini's, house where she lives with her husband, Rehmat. Problems mount for this young couple, as Mini becomes pregnant, gives birth to a baby boy. As Ketan is still unable to secure any employment, Mini gets an offer to model, which she accepts, and does not inform her employer that she is married, and has a son. She soon gets to be very busy and has her photographs appear in all leading magazines. Ketan is able to secure employment as a singer, and soon gets very popular, in order not to disappoint his female fans, he openly declares he is not married, leave alone has a son. The child, hurt, confused, and tormented by this neglect starts having psychological problems, runs away, and does what no other child has ever done in India - seek a divorce from his parents - the reason - neglect. When Meenakshi and Ketan come to know this, they are sure that this is a plot to snare their child away by none other than Jagat, who they feel wants them to separate, and have Mini move in back with him.

Title: 785. Krystallines nyhtes
description: A German woman who believes in magic falls in love with a Jewish young man.

Title: 786. I'll Love You Forever... Tonight
description: Ethan is a photographer in Los Angeles, still in his 20s, gay, and given to one-night stands that, despite his willingness, don't seem to last past the next morning. His friend Dennis invites him on a getaway to Palm Springs where other friends join them. In the course of the next few days, Dennis and Ethan's relationship goes through several changes as one plays the other, as feelings get hurt, and as Ethan witnesses other men's difficulties with jealousy, commitment, and honesty. To whom can Ethan turn for assurance? To his family, to long-time friends, to his art?

Title: 787. Galaxy of the Dinosaurs
description: A space crew must find a way to survive the chaotic world Gurgon.

Title: 788. Legend of the Roller Blade Seven
description: In a post-apocalyptic world where rollerblading is the chief means of travel, the evil Pharoah sends his minions outside the Wheel Zone to abduct a psychic. The psychic has been trained in the way of the samurai, but has shunned her training to become a Passive. Once abducted, her brother joins forces with others to try and rescue her, but they face many challenges from the Dark Side.

Title: 789. Baduk
description: Baduk is the name of the child who works in smuggling, due to poverty he and his sister separated, the sister will work as a maid, he keeps trying to reach his sister in vain, finally he escaped from Iran because he thinks that his sister left Iran, he discovered later on that she is still in Iran.

Title: 790. Oru Kochu Bhoomikulukkam
description: Sreenivasan has a dark secret from his past. When his friend Siddique wants to marry a girl Shobhana , who knows him from college , Sreenivasan tries everything to prevent it from happening. So that his wife and friends won't find out about his dark secret.

Title: 791. Kiekeboe: Het witte bloed
description: The Kiekeboe family vacation is disrupted by a vampire plot involving artificial blood.

Title: 792. Life on the Edge
description: Earthquakes and aftershocks forces a group of residents stranded at a party to reevaluate their lives, as one grueling situation after another, prompts surprise and comedy.

Title: 793. Beauty Investigator
description: A cop goes undercover as a nightclub singer to catch a professional hitman.

Title: 794. Aquí, el que no corre... vuela
795. Lethal Ninja
description: An American ninja's wife is held hostage by a sadistic Nazi chemist on an Asian island. He teams up with an African-American ninja to rescue her.

Title: 796. Otto - Der Liebesfilm
description: Armor gets caught by God playing video games and must now make a perfect match for two people to fall in love.

Title: 797. False Lady
description: Man gets killed by a falling pot. He wasn't supposed to die and his spirit must return to his body. Yet he finds out that his body has been cremated, so he takes up residence in the body of a car-crash victim, with a new name Mandy.

Title: 798. The Room

Title: 915. Steele's Law
description: Steele, a plainclothes Chicago cop, is recruited by the FBI to foil an assassination plot in Dallas, Texas. It seems that Joe Keno, a former nemesis of Steele, is planning to assassinate the Iraqi ambassador to the U.S. Keno is funded by several prominent Texas businessmen. Steele travels to Dallas, where he makes friends with Barnes; Steele is contacted by a Dallas-based FBI agent who sets him up with his contact, "Peacekeeper." Joe Keno has abandoned previous ways and methods; the assassin is now also a serial killer. While Keno's victims are found in abandoned warehouses and parks, Steele encounters numerous obstacles. The Chicago cop encounters friendly Texas racists, is ambushed in a redneck saloon, and battles the incompetence and petty jealousy of Dallas police. Meanwhile Steele tries to stop Keno before the Iraqi ambassador becomes his next victim.

Title: 916. Therku Theru Machan
description: Subramani (Sathyaraj) and Parimala (Bhanupriya) fall in love with each other. Devaraj (Mansoor Ali Khan), the owner of a gambling club, also wants to marry Parimala. What transpires later forms the crux of the story.

Title: 917. The Finishing Touch
description: Sam Stone is a cop with personal as well as professional problems. Stone investigates a series of killings in the night club scene. His exwife, also a cop, goes undercover to find the killer and Stone is faced with a double problem: keeping her alive and catching the killer before another woman is killed.

Title: 919. Thalasthanam
description: Unnikrishnan gets in trouble and is later killed for beating up Pappan, a popular face in student politics. However, when his brother learns the truth about his death, he sets out to seek revenge.

Title: 921. Sun of the Sleepless
description: About a doctor named Gela Bendeliani (Elgudzha Burduli) and his wealthless family in Tbilisi in Soviet Georgia. In the film Gela Bendeliani has an unlimited capacity for generosity and forgiveness.

Title: 922. Kino
description: Before dying, feeling very ill, the italian father Francisco Eusebio Kino remembers when he was younger and traveled from Europe to New Spain (México). Although he wanted travel to China, his superior send him to the new continent. It was the end of XVI. He joined Admiral Atondo as a cartographer and a missioner. Once he discovered the peoples from America, he believed that his place was just there. As a goal, he wanted to stablish a mission in the "island" of California, but the land was so harsh. Instead of that, he had to save souls in Sonora, also dry lands. As a humble and warm heart he had to see how spanish forces mistreated the indians.

Title: 923. Can Go Up, Can Go Down
description: Three friends embark on a series of comedic shenanigans after receiving security guard training from an unreliable source.

Title: 924. Chembaruthi
description: Raja, a rich lad falls in love with Chembaruthi, a maid who works in his grandmother's house. His family rejects their love due to the social differences. What will he do to marry his sweetheart?

Title: 925. Kamaladalam
description: Nandagopan is a respected dance teacher. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when his wife commits suicide causing him to become an alcoholic and compulsive rule breaker.

Title: 926. Exiled in America
description: A Central American revolutionary is captured and tortured by government forces. He escapes and flees to the US, hiding out in a rural area where he is sheltered by a Christian sanctuary movement. His wife gets a job at a local diner run by one of the town's shadier women, and soon a CIA assassination team shows up, looking for him.

Title: 927. Best of the Best
description: The son of a crooked cop follows in his father's footsteps. He joins an elite group of cops known as the "Flying Tigers" and learns the true meaning of justice.

Title: 928. Mean Tricks
description: Hornsby, a recently retired FBI agent, goes to South America to find his old partner Mendoza who is soon killed. With local cop Rodriguez and PD secretary Candelaria Hornsby follows the traces of a drug smuggling ring.

Title: 929. A Mission to Kill
description: His activities in Viet Nam would be denied by the U S Government. Only two others providing similar service returned to the states. Now he's getting mental help in a military institution, escapes, and must be recaptured.

Title: 932. Kuang
description: Set in late 1890s,a southeast China small town, right after first Sino Japanese War,a young woman who married a local grocery store owner,falls in an extramarital affair with her husband's brother-in-law. turns everyone's life upside-down.

Title: 933. Susan Tyrrell: My Rotten Life, a Bitter Operetta
description: "It's a little raw and crude right now, but I want this to be 'My Rotten Life' as a dessert, not as a liver pill." Susan Tyrrell's performance recorded.

Title: 934. Great Conquest: Romance of Three Kingdoms
description: Begins during the Yellow Turban rebellion that initiated the downfall of the Han dynasty. Liu Bei is striving to find a way to bring order to a chaotic world. Cao Cao ponders destiny as hero in a chaotic world, or villain in a peaceful one

Title: 935. Now You See It, Now You Don't
description: This is a screwball-comedy in Hong Kong style. Chow Yun Fat plays the spoiled village hetman of a tiny village in Hong Kong. The plot revolves around his love interest who has run off to work in downtown Hong Kong and many culture clashes between the peasants and urban life are highlighted.

Title: 936. A skorpió megeszi az ikreket reggelire
description: This is a story of a man who wants to grasp and hold his beloved one by him and a woman who insists on that her love can't be grasped.

Title: 937. Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: The Afterglow of Zeon
description: After the One Year War, peace was signed between Zeon and the Earth Federation. Three years later, however, some remaining forces of Zeon who never gave up steal the new Federation mobile suit Gundam Unit 2, capable of Nuclear Strike and use it as its primary weapon in their Operation Stardust. Can Federation rookie pilot Kou Uraki and his Gundam Unit 1 match up against Zeon's Anavel Gato, the Nightmare of Solomon, and still be albe to stop Zeon before it's too late? This is movie is the compilation of the 13-episode made-for-video series "Kidô senshi Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory" (1991)

Title: 938. Is That All There Is?
description: Award winning director Lindsay Anderson (If..., O Lucky Man!) subverts the mockumentary genre and presents to the audience a detailed and humored account of what truly means to be Lindsay Anderson in his daily routine, meeting with artists, actors and regular people, discussing what's going on in the world at the time. And, of course, there's plenty of time for him to discuss some of his passions: movies and theatre, remembering of his time as a former film critic and stage director.

Title: 939. Pink Lady
description: A depressing, sweet tale about the relationship between two former school girls that cannot survive in a strict, ignorant world.

Title: 941. Al-Qatila
description: How many Egyptian giallo/rape-revenge/social dramas do you know of? Well, now you now of at least one. One might hope for something really, really weird and alien from such a concoction but you'd only be partially correct. While it does have some (very) surprising sleaze as well as some odd hypnotic passages for the most part LADY KILLER kind of just plods along, dealing with its own conservative Arab society concerns, uninterested in whatever the outside world might think.

Title: 942. Boy Praning: Utak pulbura
description: Willie Boy (Ian Veneracion), a young man who gets drawn into a world of crime and corruption. With the help of his friends, Willie Boy uses his intelligence and courage to fight against villains and establish justice.

Title: 943. The Pied Piper of Hamlin
description: A grandfather relates to his two grandchildren, the story of the township of Hamlin which was plagued with rats. In their moment of desperation, a stranger, a Pied Piper, appears with a promise to rid the town of rats forever in exchange for 200 gold bars. The Piper fulfils his promise by playing magical music which attracts all the rats as he led them to the river to drown. When the townspeople fail to keep their promise and pay him only 1 gold bar, he vows revenge - and delivers... The moral of the story - Always keep your promise - always pay the piper.

Title: 944. Dead End
description: A pair of serial killers travel the Southwest, committing murders along the way. However, their crimes come back to haunt them as they pass through the desert on an Indian reservation when they begin to see what they think are the ghosts of their victims.

Title: 946. Meera
description: Meera's life changes after she witnesses a policeman committing a murder. He then vows to kill her but her friend Jeeva sets out to help her.

Title: 947. Assolto per aver commesso il fatto
description: A former inspector of the SIAE, focusing everything on his cunning and stubbornness, tries to grab (even in fraudulent ways) all the televisions or private radios that come to hand; all to please a mysterious woman named Gilda.

Title: 948. Honeymoon
description: An unemployed male, forced to marry a wealthy woman, is not only evicted but must also pose as her servant.

Title: 949. Exorcist Master
description: When a Catholic church in a small Chinese town falls prey to an evil combing the powers of Western and Chinese vampires, Taoist priest Uncle Nine (Lam Ching Ying) and Catholic priest Wu (Wu Ma) must overcome religious and cultural differences in order to defeat the vampire.

Title: 950. The Warrior's Heart
description: A Norwegian nurse falls in love with a Finnish soldier in the Winter War of 1939/40 between Finland and the USSR. After settling down World War II erupts, and he is lost in Finland, as she falls in love with Maximilian, a German soldier.

Title: 951. Chaz and Vinnie's Sex Adventure
description: Two college students produce the craziest film project for their professor that takes Palm Springs by storm.

Title: 952. Dharavi
description: Rajkaran lives in Dharavi, the biggest slum in the world. He aspires to start his own business and even manages to do it. But several misfortunes land him back to square one, penniless and alone.

Title: 953. The Assassinator
description: Chris McCall, a seemingly perfect family man who secretly works as a top contract killer for an outfit known as The Office, risks losing everything when he kills the wrong person.

Title: 954. Mary from Beijing
description: Ma Lei which sounds like "Mary" is a Chinese citizen, living in Hong Kong as the kept woman of a jeweler. She wishes for two things: to get her Hong Kong Identity Card, which will enable her to get work as a legal immigrant; and to marry her boyfriend. However, obtaining an Identity Card is not easy, and getting her boyfriend to introduce her to his family is even more difficult. Mary soon befriends her neighbour, Ken. Their relationship builds. When Mary breaks up with her boyfriend, she moves out, disappearing from Ken's life. She is convinced that they are fated never to meet again when they run into each other literally.

Title: 955. Narito ang puso ko
description: A woman who regained her veterinarian lover after their son was accidentally shot by the son of a prominent politician must do her best to regain the life of their comatose son to bring back the old happy life they once had.

Title: 956. Rukopis
description: A distinctive feature of the boys from the Espada courtyard club is their unwillingness to put up with injustice, cruelty, wherever it manifests itself: in the yard, on the street, at school or in a distant country. They have everything to do with it. Whether the kid is offended, whether hooligans stick to someone, whether their peer is killed in Chile - the boys from the Espada are always ready to draw their swords in defense of a person.

Title: 957. Mujhse Dosti Karoge
description: The story follows 9-year-old Gul Hasan, living in Rann of Kutch desert, whose dreams of a better life lead him on a journey blurring fantasy and reality. The critically acclaimed film won multiple national and international awards.

Title: 958. Suburb Murder
description: In April 1985, two expatriate students Kenneth McBride, age 17, and 18 year-old Nicola Myers were beaten, raped, and murdered by a teenage gang. Based on the true story of Hong Kong's Braemar Hill murders.

Title: 959. Run Melos!
description: A story about the friendship between two men, during the reign of Dionysius II, at Syracuse, Sicily. Selinteus firmly believes that Melos (a strange friend) will keep his promise. But many forces are at work against.

Title: 961. November
description: A young girl is both schizophrenic and abuses drugs. She has many fantasies involving fire. A medical student sends her to a senior doctor and especially instructs her to tell that he sent her. The doctor's attitude is that it is natural to feel a little depressed at this time of the year. When she asks if he is not going to make an examination he answers that that is not necessary. This is less than one week before the catastrophe. But from another corner she encounters a most sincere will to help her, viz. from a Catholic priest concerned with exorcism. It is not his fault that she is starch naked in one scene. But it cannot be a pleasure to a celibate to carry a young and beautiful female body in his arms. After a few days of exorcism she has become calm and quiet; the devils had left her. On the next day she effectively chains herself inside a car, throws the key away, pours gasoline all over, and lightens it. One would wish this was also a psychotic fantasy but it is not.

Title: 962. Landslide
description: Amnesiac geologist Robert (Bob) Boyd is working on a project that he had been retained to do. He has no memory of the past, but during the project, his memory begins to return, and the memories are not happy ones.

Title: 963. Humanoids from Atlantis
description: Film maker Ken Adams has received financing for his first documentary on a local lake. Unfortunately, the assignment will put him and his partner Julie on a collision course with the last survivor of the aquatic city of Atlantis.

Title: 964. Small Kill
description: Children are being kidnapped and held for ransom. If the parents don't cooperate, the kids show up dead. An undercover cop gets involved in the case, and his investigation leads him to a connection between a banker and a fortune teller.

Title: 965. Sargam
description: Kuttan Thamburan, who is epileptic, plans to get married to Thankamani, unaware of the fact that she is in love with his best friend, Haridas.

Title: 967. The American Gangster
description: Program provides an historical archive of how gangsters took advantage of changes in public policy to gain wealth and power in the first half of the twentieth century and how they met their ends. The post World War I raise and fall of bank robbery gangs is briefly described.

Title: 968. Gudrun
description: The 12 year old girl Gudrun experiences the end of childhood in a little town near Nuremberg. Her father is fighting far away on the Russian front, her mother packs Gudrun off to her grandmother.

Title: 969. Albert souffre
description: Albert dreams of going to Australia. Jérôme loves Jeanne, but ignores her while cramming for exams.

Title: 970. La valle di pietra
description: In 18th Century Bohemia, a government surveyor meets a priest during a lunch and is intrigued by him. Years later, in a stony valley, the two men meet again and form a deep friendship.

Title: 971. Alibi perfetto
description: An amazing Italian thriller directed by Aldo Lado. Tony and Lisa, both policemen, want to capture a drug trafficker named Mancini. In the meantime, they will have to deal with a maniac known as "The Full Moon Killer".

Title: 972. Valerie
description: Lesbian vampire Valerie sets her sights on the nubile Laurie.

Title: 973. Kinder der Landstrasse
description: After setting in Switzerland, a yenish family escaped their major problems at the beginning of World War Two. However, they will have to deal with the government project "Hilfswerks Barmherzigkeit den Vagantenkindern".

Title: 974. The Left Side of My Brain
description: A film that spans 16 years in the life of Raymond Salzberg, a naive would-be artist from New Jersey who eventually makes it.

Title: 975. Nottataccia
description: The shy and clumsy Latin professor Alessandro falls in love with a psychologist spying on her from a hole made in a wall.

Title: 977. Boulevard des hirondelles
description: Inspired by a story, that of a woman who, in the 1940s, organized a commando operation on Boulevard des Hirondelles to get her lover out of prison.

Title: 978. Parda Hai Parda
description: The film revolves around four happy-go-lucky friends and the predicament they fall into when they cross paths with a new girl in their neighborhood.

Title: 979. The Ghosting
description: A family is hired as caretakers for an abandoned church. Years before a man had murdered his entire family in the church, and on the day the family is to move in, the killer escapes from prison and heads toward the church.

Title: 980. Sarphira
description: Judge B.K. Sinha and his adopted son, Rajkishan are law-abider but the youngest in their house-hold, Suresh prove to be the opposite - is hot-tempered and is into shady activities. His behavior crosses the limit when he accidentally kills a man and is on the run from not only the police but his dad and brother who will not hesitate to incarcerate him.

Title: 981. Jesus vender tilbage
description: Jesus returns to Earth, gets involved in a terrorist group, but keeps his integrity.

Title: 982. Boujad: A Nest in the Heat
description: Boujad: A Nest In the Heat is a personal and anguishing look at issues of separation, independence and return. As director Hakim Belabbes chronicles his journey from his home in Chicago to visit his family in his hometown of Boujad in Morocco, his exploration of family relationships is self-conscious and at times painfully honest. We witness his most private moments with his family. Belabbes' film intimately explores the domestic spaces and religious rituals of intra-family relationships, especially when compounded by one member's break with traditional values.

Title: 984. Muskurahat
description: Retired Justice Gopichand Verma lives alone in scenic Ooty away from his family.Two friends Pritam works as a guide and Jaggan as photographer .Pritam comes across a beautiful Nandini arriving in Ooty an accommodates her in top hotel soon Pritam is called back to the hotel to take her away as she has created a havoc.Pritam finds that Nandini is insane and has no option rather then taking care of her. Pritam and Jaggan's life becomes hell with Nandini's tantrums until. Jaggan finds in newspapers that Nandini as eloped from asylum and and has a reward on her he plans with Pritam that they wont handover her to her family as the reward amount is increasing day by day and they should wait until it becomes a huge sum.Pritam finds from Nandini that she inst insane and was playing a prank to meet her father whose none other then Justice Gopichand Verma.But his family didn't allow her to meet him and put her in asylum.

Title: 985. Narges
description: Adel is a young criminal who frequently teams up with his middle-aged wife Afagh in order to carry out the most audacious schemes. But when Adel falls in love with Narges, he realises he is quite prepared to start a new life on the right side of the law. Posing as his mother, Afagh assures the bride's family that Adel is reliable, but his criminal record closes most doors in his attempts to secure a legitimate career path. Trapped in a love triangle and in the limbo of a double life, can Adel ever achieve the better future for which he is striving ?

Title: 986. Blue Jeans Gang
description: Brian (Keempee de Leon), Alan (Gary Estrada), Jerry (Kier Legaspi), Tom (Joko Diaz), Jojo (Michael Rivero), and Pat (Dennis Padilla) call themselves the BLUE JEANS GANG. They consider themselves to be more like brothers than friends. They were on their way to Baguio City to attend the wedding of Brian and Rachel Alejandro when they accidentally witness a murder in a small town and in one occasion started a brawl which led to the killing of the mayor's son then the haunting of the perpetrators which is the Blue Jeans Gang began.

Title: 988. Un vampire au paradis
description: In a posh family in the 16th district of Paris, a young teenager begins to speak Arabic overnight, the day before, she had seen on a tree overlooking the family garden, an escaped from the asylum Arab man.

Title: 989. Kill Fee
description: A reporter is tipped off about someone in LA selling American aerospace technology to the Japanese. She hires a charming P.I. to help tail the suspects etc. But things are not what they appear to be.

Title: 990. The Little Prince Said
description: A divorced Swiss couple confronts their 10-year-old daughter Violette's life-threatening tumor. While her father tries to flee with her, her mother collapses emotionally, and her stepmother focuses on treatment.

Title: 991. Le retour des Charlots
description: Antonio pretends to lose his memory to escape the wrath of his wife Amalia, who discovered him deceiving her in charming company.

Title: 992. Ville à vendre
description: A man comes to a small town in France and witness the apparent murder of a woman pharmacist. He teams up with the victim's vulgar assistant to try to solve the mystery.

Title: 993. In the Land of the Deaf
description: With unerring curiousity and sensitivity, director Philbert portrays the difficulties and joys of being deaf, offering vivid portraits of people of all ages coping with and surmounting their challenges.

Title: 994. Tutti gli uomini di Sara
description: Sarah's marriage turned from happiness into a nightmare. One month into the ceremony, she begins to receive threatening phone calls with intimate details of her sexual relations.

Title: 996. Lumayo ka man sa akin
description: Two lovers are separated but in a twist of fate, find themselves in a care of a syndicate leader. He is the bodyguard and she is the wife.

Title: 997. Parasmani
description: A belief of an ancient Temple that Lord Shiva 's idol wasn't installed there but it appeared on its own and it has three eyes one of which has a miraculous Parasmani and it comes out only on Mahashivratri day and can turn iron into gold.For centuries Dacoit have eyed to rob the Parasmani but never succeeded.Daku Toofan Singh on one of the Mahashivratri days comes to rob the Parasmani where the temple priest and his wife sacrifice their life in saving the Parasmani.The priest gives the Parasmani to his small twin daughter's Paras and Mani who run away from the temple but an accident separates them where Paras looses her memory and is raised by a courtesan who names her Reshma.Mani is adopted by a police officer when Paras and Mani grow up they fall in love with a same man Shiva everyone tries to trace the Parasmani while the cops want to protect it and Dacoit's want it for themselves.Inspector Mani then takes the help of Baba Malang a Dacoit turned Muslim reformer who will save her and the Parasmani.

Title: 998. Fratelli e sorelle
description: After 20 years of marriage, Gloria discovers that her husband has been unfaithful. With her sons she moves to St. Louis: Matteo wastes no time in settling into his new life, but for Francesco it's tough to cope with his complexes.

Title: 999. Yardbirds
description: Documentary about the '60s British rock group The Yardbirds, with interviews with the band's various members, managers and other musicians. Also shown are clips from their TV appearances, concert appearances and snips from films they've appeared in.

Title: 1000. Naya Sawan
description: Kavita (Ashwini Bhave) is a lead singer of a boy band consisting of four member Javed Jaffrey,Laxmikanth Berde,Asif Sheikh and Sahil Chaddha. She has a a very close friendship with the boys.But after her marriage her husband suspects her of having an affair with them.
